name: outside
description: you stand on the front porch of blackwood manor. the night air is cool and clean, carrying the scent of pine and distant woodsmoke. the mansion looms behind you, its dark windows reflecting the moonlight like dead eyes. the barred front door — the only entrance — stands firmly shut. the overgrown driveway leads to a rusted gate, beyond which the road home waits. you have escaped the blackwood curse... for now.

items.name: porch
items.description: the wide wooden porch creaks under your feet. a broken rocking chair sits near the door, swaying slightly in the breeze. the night sky is clear, stars visible above the tree line.

exits.description: the massive oak front door, reinforced with iron bands. it is barred from the inside with a strange mechanism. a skull-shaped indentation suggests something must be placed here to unlock it.
